topic.title: Chat
topic.shortdesc: Ask for anything in plain words, about any business. Your assistant looks it up and answers, or brings in a specialist and reports back in the same chat.

image.alt: Chat on a phone: your message, the agent's answer with its business and status, and the message box.

body.p: Type in Message and press Enter (Shift+Enter for a new line). Each answer shows which business handled it and links to its task. Follow-ups continue the same thread, so the agent remembers what you were talking about; New chat starts afresh. The chat stays on this device all day, through reloads and leaving the page; after midnight, once it has gone unused for two hours, it starts afresh by itself. Requests made in Converse are in it too, marked with a microphone. Wait for one answer before sending the next.
If the work needs your approval, the proposals appear right under the answer, so you can approve them without leaving Chat.
Converse in the box switches to hands-free voice, and Fold switches back; on a touch screen, swipe up on the strip down the box's right-hand edge, and down again. See Converse.

topic.title: Choose who you are talking to

body.p: Send to is the Assistant by default: it works across all your businesses, with every business's tools. Pick a business to file the chat under it instead; changing it starts a new thread.
You can also name the business or a specialist at the start of the message:

ul.li: dms: what sold yesterday? is a Desktop Machine Shop task for the assistant.
video: plan next week's spindle video goes to the Video Producer.
blog: write up the collet rack build goes to the Blog Writer.
software: make the digest arrive at 8am goes to the Software Lead.

body.p: A specialist's id, title or any name in its Address as list on the Businesses page works. Other names, such as support: or pricing:, are not special: the message goes to the assistant.

Tick Read replies aloud at the top to hear each reply as it arrives (the same switch is on a task's page). It is off by default and remembered per device. Stop appears while it is speaking and cuts it off mid-reply.

You can keep writing while the agent is still working: each message you send waits, shown dimmed as queued, and goes out by itself, in order, once the agent has answered. Cancel removes a queued message; starting a new chat clears the queue. Queued messages are kept only while the page is open.

While the agent is working on a message, Stop on its reply stops it, along with any work it handed on to a specialist; the reply then says stopped, and your next message carries on from there. Stop & edit on your message stops the agent and puts the message, with its files, back in the box: change it and press Send, and the agent works on the corrected version instead. Cancel edit leaves it stopped. Queued messages wait until the edit is sent.

While any agent is working, Stop all appears in the top bar. After you confirm, it stops every task that is running, queued or waiting for the budget. Each stopped task can be retried or replied to later.
The microphone button fills the message box with what you say. Press it again when you are done, check the text, and send. It is hidden where the device can't listen.
